snippet.title: Cloudheim - Story Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description: Embark on a sky-bound adventure in Cloudheim. After a world-shattering event, you’re called by the gods to rebuild from your floating base on the giant turtle Odin Shell. Explore dynamic islands, dive into destructible combat arenas where physics is your weapon, craft weapons and gear in real-time alongside friends, and turn your workshop into a thriving shop in the clouds. Whether alone or with up to four players, the realm of Cloudheim is yours to save or reinvent. Check out this new story trailer from the Galaxies Autumn showcase.
